title: feat(CE-18): Referral instructions API — per-org/provider required fields + custom config
body:
## Summary

New `GET /api/referral-instructions?orgId=&providerId=` endpoint that returns the fields a sender must fill out before sending a referral to a given org or provider.

**Hierarchy**: Requirements resolve in layers — platform baseline → org-level → provider-level. Each layer can add fields or override `required` on existing ones. Baseline fields (`patient.firstName/lastName/dateOfBirth`, `referringProvider.npi`, `procedure`, `priority`, `clinicalNotes`) are always present. The schema is ready for a future `location_id` column when locations land.

**Schema**: New `referral_requirements` table with nullable `org_id`/`provider_id` (check constraint: at least one set), `required_fields` (jsonb array of `{key, label, type, required, options?}`), and `custom_config` (open jsonb).

**Merge logic** in `lib/referralInstructions.ts`: `mergeFields(base, custom)` matches by `key` — existing keys get overridden, new keys appended. Resolution: baseline ← org config ← provider config.

**Seed data**: Cleveland Clinic (insurance + SOAP note format), UCSF (contact method + imaging), Dr. Chen (provider-level prior imaging on top of Cleveland's org config). Mayo/MGH/etc. return baseline only.

**Note**: Endpoint is `GET /api/referral-instructions?orgId=&providerId=` instead of the originally-proposed `GET /api/organizations/[id]/referral-instructions` — discussed and approved in CE-18 comments. Single endpoint with query params handles the hierarchy (org, provider, future location) without needing separate routes per entity type.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/c30bc687b89248eb9fba110018c8a73c
Requested by: @ErikLindeman12
